items.title: Welcome to Agents Week
items.summary: Agents Week explores how cloud infrastructure must evolve to serve autonomous agents rather than human browsers. Join us as we unpack the storage, execution, and security primitives needed for an agent-native web.
items.content: This week is Agents Week. As we started thinking about and planning the week, we wrestled with a broader question of what it means to support this new era of agents and what a purpose-built foundation for agents actually looks like. Which brought us to a simpler framing: what is an Agent Cloud? We quickly realized however, that our framing was wrong. Not because it’s the wrong question to ask, but because of who we were asking — ourselves, instead of our agents.
